name: Y2K9s Dog Sports Club

reviews.text: Do you love dogs? This is a great place, slightly hidden, if you love watching dogs or want to train your dog to compete in things like agility.  The people are friendly and the dogs seem to be having a great time. Be sure to check it out.
reviews.author: Lynn

reviews.text: We have been training at y2k9s for 8 years. Its a great family and dog friendly establishment. knowledgeable instructors
reviews.author: Anastasia Ayzenberg

reviews.text: This facility has so much to offer! I've gone to puppy preschool, puppy class, advanced manners, sports prep, competitive obedience, scent work, and my agility class journey. My 8yr old rescue has really flourished in their positive training and my puppy has been building her confidence as I plan to also work her up to agility training. They even offer conformation classes that I plan to join as well as Rally, Parkour, Disk dog, and Freestyle to highlight a few others. Everything is meant to be a fun and positive experience.
reviews.author: Shannon Balcer

reviews.text: We had a super fun time here with a group Beginner Agility class arranged by the Keystone Portuguese Water Dog Club. It was great to see our dog Barclay and our friend’s dogs Amur, Nikki, and Bowie so happy together while learning new skills! Highly recommended❣️!!!
reviews.author: Louanne James

reviews.text:
Phenomenal lessons from instructor who love dogs. Even in a group class my instructor (Tina) is making sure my dog (and me) get custom lessons for where my dog (and I) are at skill wise. When other dogs more skilled dogs trained she still teaches me by showing how I can get my dog to relax and not stress.

I have also worked with Alexa and she is also super talented. Watching the instructors interact with mine and others' dogs teaches me patience and problem solving.

What I appreciate most is the emphasis placed on my dog's overall demeanor and confidence...and not just the skills we are learning in the class.

Each lesson is capped with homework and a detailed email recapping the class.

Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Gene Fish, D.C.
